title: Entry
description: Formal spec REQ-6-2. A guardian or successor entry -- a snapshot of that identity's own log at the time it was recorded.

did.description: The guardian or successor's own did:guardian DID (REQ-4-1 through REQ-4-3).

anchor.description: That DID's own anchor (REQ-5-7) -- fixed for the life of the identity, not something that changes between snapshots.

keys.description: 1 to 8 distinct Multikey strings (REQ-5-8), that DID's own keys as they were when this entry was recorded.

consent.description: The operation hash of an acceptWard in that DID's own log, naming the ward this entry belongs to.
